# RiseFlow - Full Context for LLM Retrieval

RiseFlow is a school operations platform for modern schools, with emphasis on African education workflows.

Capabilities include:
- School onboarding and account setup
- Student records and lifecycle tracking
- School fee visibility and related workflows
- Parent-teacher communication features
- Transcript verification via secure public verification URLs
- Role-based dashboards for school admins, teachers, students, parents, and super admins

Public intent pages:
- / : product overview and platform positioning
- /onboard : school onboarding journey
- /affiliate-program and /affiliate/signup : partner growth channel
- /privacy and /terms : trust and legal policy pages

Indexing and canonical:
- Canonical base URL: https://rise-flow-tech.vercel.app/
- Sitemap: https://rise-flow-tech.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy disallows private role dashboards and login routes.
